qa_pairs.question: What is the title of this brake system diagram?
What section and page number is this diagram from?
qa_pairs.answer: This is page 34 - 10a from the service manual.

qa_pairs.question: How many brake disc assemblies are shown in this routing diagram?
qa_pairs.answer: Four brake disc assemblies are shown - one at each wheel position.

qa_pairs.question: What type of lines are used to show the brake line connections in this diagram?
qa_pairs.answer: Dashed lines are used to show the brake line routing connections between components.

qa_pairs.question: Where is the main brake component (master cylinder/ABS unit) positioned in this layout?
qa_pairs.answer: The main brake component is positioned centrally in the diagram, with brake lines routing out to all four wheels.

qa_pairs.question: What additional component is shown with dotted lines connected to the left front brake assembly?
qa_pairs.answer: There appears to be an additional brake component connected with dotted lines to the left front brake assembly, likely representing a brake sensor or ABS component.

qa_pairs.question: How are the brake lines routed from the central component to the wheels?
qa_pairs.answer: The brake lines route from the central component outward to each of the four wheel positions using dashed lines to indicate the connection paths.

qa_pairs.question: What do the circular components at each corner of the diagram represent?
qa_pairs.answer: The circular components at each corner represent the brake disc and caliper assemblies at each wheel position.
